#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "$1" ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s DESTINATION\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
dest=$1
case $dest in
    /*) ;;
    *) dest=./$dest ;;
esac

if ! mkdir -p "$dest"; then
    printf 'install-report: cannot create destination: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! dest=$(CDPATH= cd "$dest" && pwd -P); then
    printf 'install-report: cannot access destination: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for file in summary.txt detail.txt; do
    if ! cp "$base/templates/$file" "$dest/$file"; then
        printf 'install-report: cannot install %s in %s\n' "$file" "$1" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done
if ! cp "$base/launcher" "$dest/run-report"; then
    printf 'install-report: cannot install launcher in %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! chmod +x "$dest/run-report"; then
    printf 'install-report: cannot make launcher executable in %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 1
fi
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod +x bin/install-report
/bin/sh -n bin/install-report && sed -n '1,240p' bin/install-report
